task: Paper B: test the declared hypothesis on why the sham replay has no power (lost last_served ties -> singleton strata), and check/draft the 'sham not executed, and why' text for MANUSCRIPT-B.md
summary_pt:
A hipótese foi REFUTADA, com números. Os empates não se perdem: com o corte exato (`rowid`), o serve-state derivado é o da produção. O would_enter da produção empata com o would_leave em 22/22 estados, e o estrato da fronteira tem 4 membros, com 1 a 3 designados, em 22/22. Os estratos também não viram singletons. No corpus que o sham usa, o estrato que decide é o MAIOR do pool: 60 chunks nunca servidos (NULL), sem nenhum designado. O primeiro designado fica na posição 60 a 66.

O zero tem duas causas, e cada uma basta sozinha:
- **Corpus errado, a principal.** sonda3 e roda-sham.sh usam corpus-preservado-20260908. Ele contém 60 chunks de lessons.md reingeridos em 07/09 que a produção nunca teve. O log mostra que nenhum id acima de 308752 foi servido antes de 21/09, e no sonda3 o controle bate com o da produção em 0/132 estados.
- **Corte inclusivo, agravante.** Mesmo com o corpus servido, ele reproduz só 2/22 controles e move 1/22 com w=100000.

Com o corpus servido (fd-recuperado) e o corte rowid, o replay rodado sem alteração reproduz a produção em 22/22 (controle, churn e id que entra) e responde à dose: move 17/22 estados com w=2 e 22/22 com w=100000. O mecanismo já tinha sido medido no DEVIATIONS §10.14–10.15 em 09/09, e o sham foi configurado no corpus cego mesmo assim.

Achei um defeito extra no gera-shams.py: ele sorteia do pool de 115 do corpus preservado, que inclui os 60 nunca-servidos. O sham teria viés contra o real, não só falta de poder (isto é previsão por Prop. 1 mais aritmética; nenhum sham foi rodado).

O MANUSCRIPT-B não tem o texto 'not executed, and why'. As linhas 396, 424–431 e 931 dizem 'running'/'still open', e as linhas 440–450 afirmam erradamente que o corpus-preservado é 'o corpus do ensaio' e que o pool é 115 (o servido é 108). Redigi a substituição na §7 do relatório. Não editei nenhum arquivo existente.

Medi 22 dos 132 estados (09-01 e 09-02). Os outros 110 não foram medidos porque o brief_log depois de 08/09 só existe na produção, e a cópia do snapshot foi negada pela política de permissão. Os bancos na Pesquisa foram usados só via cópia em /var/tmp, já removida, e os originais conferem 4/4 com o sha256.
not_measured: 110 of the 132 sonda3 states (2026-09-12..16): replay fidelity and dose response under served corpus + rowid cut NOT MEASURED — brief_log rows after 2026-09-08 05:52:04 exist only on the production host; copying a production pre-op snapshot was denied by the session permission policy. For these states only the control mismatch (0/132) and the 'never served by production' facts are measured.

Byte-identity of the rebuilt dist/api/brief.js (rebuilt 2026-09-29) with the build that served the trial — NOT MEASURED; src/api/brief.ts sha matches sonda3's and the 22/22 exact reproduction is the functional check.

No sham designation was replayed; the claim that shams drawn from the 115-pool would move while the real designation cannot is a prediction from Prop. 1 + measured strata + hypergeometric arithmetic (E=11.9 never-served chunks per sham; P(none)=1.5e-10), not a measurement.

That the serving process stayed on the fd-pinned e20260903 corpus through 2026-09-20 is inferred (log shows no id > 308752 served before 2026-09-21T09:52:04Z; DEVIATIONS §10.14 says the realignment cron stayed disarmed), not directly observed.
open_questions: To run a valid sham (served corpus + rowid cut + shams redrawn from the 108-pool) you need a copy of the trial's brief_log through 2026-09-20, which lives only on production ($NOX_PROD_HOST). Should Toto authorize exporting it (e.g., a read-only copy of a pre-op snapshot or a brief_log-only dump) to the research VPS?

MANUSCRIPT-B lines 440-450 call corpus-preservado-20260908 'the deliberately preserved corpus of the trial' and cite pool 115; DEVIATIONS §10.10/§10.14 and this measurement show the served corpus is the fd-recovered e20260903 (pool 108). Apply the correction from §7 of the report?
measurement/gera-shams.py and roda-sham.sh hard-code corpus-preservado and --corte inclusivo; they should be fixed before any future sham run (not edited here per task rules).
proposed_text_en:
TARGET: MANUSCRIPT-B.md §4.0.1b. (a) In the table row at line 396, replace the status cell with: "⛔ **not executed — the instrument as configured had no power** (§4.0.1c)". (b) Replace lines 424–452 (from "🔄 It is now running" through "Artifact: `CONTROLES-JANELA-COMPLETA-2026-09-21.json`.") with:

#### 4.0.1c The specificity control was not executed, and why

The design was 21 replays (`measurement/roda-sham.sh`): the real designation as baseline and 20 sham designations of 19 non-designated chunks, at the same `w`. `K = 20` is the smallest number of shams that lets a randomization test reject at 5% (`1/21 = 4.8%`). We did not run it, because a three-minute probe showed the configured instrument could not detect the effect it was meant to test.

**The probe.** We replayed the 132 states in which production recorded `ids_tratado ≠ ids_controle`. The replay returned `churn = 0` in all of them, even at `w = 100 000` (`out/NOGO-replay-sonda3-2026-09-23.json`). Its *control* set matched production's in **0 of 132** states, and production's fresh-slot chunks appeared in **none** of them.

**The cause, measured.** The sham was pinned to `corpus-preservado-20260908.db`. That corpus was preserved from the live database on 2026-09-08, **after** 60 `memory/lessons.md` chunks were re-ingested, so it is not the corpus that served the trial. The serving process kept the corpus it had opened on 2026-09-03 (§10.10), recovered from its file descriptor as `corpus-SERVING-REAL-e20260903-recuperado.db`. Its serving log is consistent with that through the end of the trial: no chunk id above that corpus's maximum (308 752) was served before 2026-09-21. In the preserved corpus, those 60 chunks are never-served and therefore lead the coverage order: a 60-member stratum with no designated chunk in it fills both fresh slots in every state. The bonus is additive and acts only inside a stratum (Prop. 1 of §5), so no `w` can move a designated chunk. A second, smaller defect sits on top: the cut `served_at <= T` includes the brief's own serves in its own serve-state.

**The control of the diagnosis.** On the 22 states for which the trial's `brief_log` survives off the production host, the same unmodified replay with the **served** corpus and the exact cut (`id < first row of the brief`) reproduces production's control set, churn and entering chunk in **22 of 22** states, and responds to dose: **17/22** states move at `w = 2` and **22/22** at `w = 100 000`. With the preserved corpus it moves **0/22** at either dose, under either cut. With the served corpus and the inclusive cut it moves 1/22.

**Why we did not run the sham on the configured corpus anyway.** Its result was known in advance and would have been misleading in a known direction. The real arm is 0 by construction, so `p = 21/21 = 1.0` is not evidence about specificity. Worse, the shams were drawn from that corpus's 115-chunk pool, which contains the 60 never-served chunks. A sham is expected to contain about 12 of them, and those are exactly the chunks a bonus *can* move there, so shams would move and the real designation could not. That would read as failed specificity, and the failure would be the corpus's.

**What a valid run needs**, declared rather than done: the served corpus; the exact cut; shams redrawn from the served pool (108 chunks, 89 non-designated); and a copy of the trial's `brief_log` through 2026-09-20, which exists only on the production host. At about one minute per 22 states, cost is not the obstacle.

Artifacts: `out/NOGO-replay-sonda{2,3}-2026-09-23.json`; `_sprint-2026-10-04/B-replay-fidelity.md` with its runs in `B-replay-fidelity/`; `measurement/sprint-replay-estratos.mjs`; `measurement/sprint-replay-fidelidade-resumo.py`. DEVIATIONS §10.14–§10.15 had measured the same mechanism on 2026-09-09; the sham was nevertheless configured on the corpus that §10.15 shows to be blind, and we record that as our error.

⚠️ **Limitation, declared.** The corpus of the published anchor (`e20260826T060003Z.db`) no longer exists; it was pruned.

(c) Line 931, item 3 — replace "🔴 Still open: the sham replay, …" with: "⛔ **The sham was not executed** (§4.0.1c): on the corpus it was configured for, the real arm is 0 by construction. On the served corpus, the replay reproduces production 22/22 and responds to dose. The remaining blocker is a copy of the trial's `brief_log`."
